title: Run the study and record deviations
summary: Check readiness, preserve the study design and record changes without moving raw responses into an agent.
steps: Pilot the exact design links, instructions, assignment, consent, keyboard flow and device behavior. Confirm that both versions use comparable tasks and scoring.
Use the field list generated for this study and its actual Qualtrics route. Do not invent field names or mix separate survey and embedded collection routes.
Check the signal against the intended behavior. A fired event is not necessarily comprehension, confidence or successful completion.
Track recruited, eligible, assigned, task-scored and follow-up-completed counts separately. Check unequal dropout and tracking differences before comparing designs.
Follow the predefined stopping rule. Document technical pauses, restarts, exclusions and protocol changes with their reasons; do not stop because a preferred result appeared.
Keep identifiers, raw Qualtrics/Medallia exports and private session notes on approved systems. Servant does not fetch survey responses.
questions: Have assignment and measurement been checked end to end?
What changed during fieldwork, and how could it affect interpretation?
example: If one version fails to record a completion signal, pause and investigate. Do not silently count those missing signals as failed tasks.
